doc.summary: Health report assembly for the LazyOwn C2 web layer.
doc.description:
Contract: probes always run and their results always drive the aggregated
status and HTTP code, but the detailed ``checks`` (and ``daemon``) payloads
are only included when ``detailed`` is true (loopback caller or
authenticated operator). Building ``checks`` in a dedicated structure
guarantees a remote caller always receives a valid aggregated response
instead of a 500 when details are withheld.

name: gather_health
signature: def gather_health(probes: Sequence[tuple[str, Callable[[], str]]], on_error: Callable[[str, BaseException], None] | None = None) -> dict[str, str]

doc.summary: Run every probe and collect per-check statuses.

params.name: probes
params.description: Sequence of ``(name, probe)`` pairs; ``probe`` returns the status string (``"ok"``, ``"stopped"``, ...) or raises.

params.name: on_error
params.description: Optional logging hook called with the check name and the raised exception.

returns.description: Mapping of check name to status string (``"error"`` on failure).

name: build_health_report
signature: def build_health_report(checks: Mapping[str, str], detailed: bool = False, daemon_status: Any = None) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], int]

doc.summary: Assemble the JSON payload and HTTP code for the health endpoint.

params.name: detailed
params.description: Whether to include the ``checks`` map and ``daemon`` status in the response body.

params.name: daemon_status
params.description: Optional daemon status payload (only embedded when ``detailed`` is true).

returns.description:
Tuple ``(payload, status_code)``; the code is 503 when any check
differs from ``"ok"``, else 200.
